Author:     Hao Lin <hao.lin@samsung.com>
AuthorDate: Wed Sep 23 13:25:57 2026 +0800
Commit:     hao.lin <hao.lin@samsung.com>
CommitDate: Wed Sep 23 13:52:01 2026 +0800

    Build the static libclang archive for libc++ consumers
    
    Build libclang.a when build_with_libcxx is set, as required by the
    bpftrace static subpackage built from source (bpftrace 7831fb34).
    
    Place LIBCLANG_BUILD_STATIC alongside LLVM_ENABLE_LIBCXX under the
    existing build_with_libcxx condition. Apart from this option, spec
    expansion is identical to the baseline under the default configuration,
    _toolchain_override gcc, _toolchain gcc and undefined _toolchain.
    llvm.spec already forces clang through _toolchain_override when
    _toolchain is defined; this is not a new GCC override guarantee.
    
    Verified by full LLVM RPM builds on armv7l (22 RPMs) and aarch64
    (12 RPMs), with the libclang archives using libc++ symbols and no
    observed std::__cxx11 symbols.

diff --git a/packaging/llvm.spec b/packaging/llvm.spec
index 15a4f7367..75d830e99 100644
--- a/packaging/llvm.spec
+++ b/packaging/llvm.spec
@@ -236,6 +236,7 @@ cmake \
 %if %{defined _toolchain}
 %if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
     -DLLVM_ENABLE_LIBCXX=ON \
+    -DLIBCLANG_BUILD_STATIC=ON \
     -DCMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS="-fuse-ld=lld -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--no-as-needed -lc++abi -Wl,--as-needed" \
     -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-fuse-ld=lld -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--no-as-needed -lc++abi -Wl,--as-needed" \
 %else

commit db5b49afa7836db0414140208b2d3ab4f4aa7293
Author:     Hao Lin <hao.lin@samsung.com>
AuthorDate: Wed Sep 23 14:13:15 2026 +0800
Commit:     hao.lin <hao.lin@samsung.com>
CommitDate: Wed Sep 23 14:13:15 2026 +0800

    Build static libc++ and libc++abi archives for clang toolchains
    
    Build and install the static libc++ and libc++abi archives when the
    toolchain is clang, as required by the bpftrace static subpackage built
    from source (bpftrace 7831fb34). Package the archives only under the
    same condition.
    
    Keep the shared libraries, ABI linker script and unwinder settings
    unchanged. With the GCC override, a literal GCC toolchain or an undefined
    toolchain, all four static build/install switches remain OFF and the
    archive file entries are absent.
    
    Verify the four macro combinations against the baseline in the retained
    ARM build root, ignoring pure blank lines left by macro definitions.

diff --git a/packaging/libcxx-runtimes.spec b/packaging/libcxx-runtimes.spec
index 2c842ae27..433e0a863 100644
--- a/packaging/libcxx-runtimes.spec
+++ b/packaging/libcxx-runtimes.spec
@@ -1,6 +1,18 @@
 %define llvm_major 22
 %define llvm_version 22.1.8
 
+%define build_static_libcxx 0
+%if %{defined _toolchain}
+%if %{toolchain_is clang}
+%define build_static_libcxx 1
+%endif
+%endif
+%if %{build_static_libcxx}
+%define libcxx_static ON
+%else
+%define libcxx_static OFF
+%endif
+
 Name:           libcxx-runtimes
 Version:        22.1.8
 Release:        1
@@ -93,17 +105,17 @@ cmake -G Ninja \
   -DLLVM_INCLUDE_TESTS=OFF \
   -DLIBCXX_ENABLE_SHARED=ON \
   -DLIBCXX_ENABLE_TIZEN_CONDVAR_VERSIONS=ON \
-  -DLIBCXX_ENABLE_STATIC=OFF \
+  -DLIBCXX_ENABLE_STATIC=%{libcxx_static} \
   -DLIBCXX_INSTALL_SHARED_LIBRARY=ON \
-  -DLIBCXX_INSTALL_STATIC_LIBRARY=OFF \
+  -DLIBCXX_INSTALL_STATIC_LIBRARY=%{libcxx_static} \
   -DLIBCXX_CXX_ABI=libcxxabi \
   -DLIBCXX_ENABLE_STATIC_ABI_LIBRARY=OFF \
   -DLIBCXX_ENABLE_ABI_LINKER_SCRIPT=ON \
   -DLIBCXX_USE_COMPILER_RT=OFF \
   -DLIBCXXABI_ENABLE_SHARED=ON \
-  -DLIBCXXABI_ENABLE_STATIC=OFF \
+  -DLIBCXXABI_ENABLE_STATIC=%{libcxx_static} \
   -DLIBCXXABI_INSTALL_SHARED_LIBRARY=ON \
-  -DLIBCXXABI_INSTALL_STATIC_LIBRARY=OFF \
+  -DLIBCXXABI_INSTALL_STATIC_LIBRARY=%{libcxx_static} \
   -DLIBCXXABI_USE_COMPILER_RT=OFF \
   -DLIBCXXABI_USE_LLVM_UNWINDER=OFF \
   -DLIBCXXABI_ENABLE_STATIC_UNWINDER=OFF \
@@ -137,6 +149,9 @@ install -m 0644 ../SOURCE_PROVENANCE \
 %{_includedir}/c++/v1
 %{_libdir}/libc++.so
 %{_libdir}/libc++experimental.a
+%if %{build_static_libcxx}
+%{_libdir}/libc++.a
+%endif
 %{_libdir}/libc++.modules.json
 %{_datadir}/libc++/v1
 %{_datadir}/doc/%{name}/SOURCE_PROVENANCE
@@ -151,6 +166,9 @@ install -m 0644 ../SOURCE_PROVENANCE \
 %manifest %{name}.manifest
 %defattr(-,root,root,-)
 %{_libdir}/libc++abi.so
+%if %{build_static_libcxx}
+%{_libdir}/libc++abi.a
+%endif
 
 %changelog
 * Tue Aug 04 2026 Toolchain ABI Team <toolchain@example.invalid> 22.1.8-1
